svg.title: Veydria Continental Schematic — Spatial Reference Map
svg.desc: Geometrically accurate schematic derived from veydria-topology.yaml. Not a final art map — a reference for verifying spatial relationships. C-shaped continent, 6 civilizations, Aethelian Basin, 5 trade routes, 6 chokepoints.
